messages:
alex: incident-bot paged me a few mins ago — embeddings service in ap-northeast-1 is returning 5xxs for a subset of traffic. I started a rolling restart of the inference fleet but we should draft an external notice. need quick eyes on wording + publish cadence. @sara @mohsin @product-ops please weigh in.

incident-bot: Pager alert triggered — embeddings-prod-apne1 error rate >50% since 2026-03-15T08:12:00Z. On-call: alex. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/embeddings-apne1. (auto-note)

alex: initial public draft below — quick suggestions welcome. Posting as a code block to make edits easier:

```
PUBLIC INCIDENT NOTICE (DRAFT)

Time: 2026-03-15 08:15 UTC
Impact: Some requests to the Embeddings API routed to ap-northeast-1 are receiving errors (HTTP 5xx). Customers in APAC may see increased failures or delays.
What we are doing: Engineers have identified elevated error rates and are performing rolling restarts of the inference fleet in the affected region. We are monitoring success metrics and request recovery.
Workaround: Customers can retry requests; global routes may fall back to other regions automatically for some customers. If you rely on APAC-only endpoints, consider re-routing to a different region if feasible.
Next update: within 30 minutes or when we have a clear remediation.

Disclaimer: We will provide a resolved notice when all pods report healthy and error rate is within normal baseline.
```

sara: thanks — looks good. two quick edits: 1) quantify the impact a bit (don’t be vague). we have metrics: ~18% of APAC- routed embedding requests failed in the spike window. say "approximately 15-20%" to be safe. 2) add affected endpoint path (POST /v1/embeddings) so customers can scan quickly. also suggest change "rolling restarts" -> "restarting a subset of inference instances" (less alarming).

mohsin: coming from CS — please add explicit instructions for affected paid customers: include a direct support link and mention that CS will proactively reach out to customers with >5% error rates. also include a note about rate-limiting retries (exponential backoff) to avoid thundering herd.

product-ops: recommend increasing cadence to 15m for the next hour, then 30m if stable. set impact severity to "Partial outage" (customers may lose embedding responses intermittently). also remove "may" overuse — prefer firm but measured phrasing. add status page link placeholder: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/###

alex: updated draft with suggestions — pasted new block below. please scan for tone and missing items.

```
PUBLIC INCIDENT NOTICE (UPDATED DRAFT)

Time: 2026-03-15 08:15 UTC
Impact: Approximately 15-20% of requests to the Embeddings API (POST /v1/embeddings) routed to the ap-northeast-1 region may receive HTTP 5xx errors. Customers in APAC may experience intermittent failures or increased latency.
What we are doing: Engineers are restarting a subset of inference instances in ap-northeast-1 to restore healthy capacity. We are monitoring request success rate, p99 latency, and instance health.
Workaround: Retry requests with exponential backoff. Where possible, route requests to a non-APAC region to avoid the affected instances. If you are a paying customer experiencing significant impact, open a ticket at https://support.redwood.ai or contact your CS rep directly.
Next update: within 15 minutes.
Severity: Partial outage
Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1867777777

We will publish a resolved notice once error rates return to baseline across the region.
```

oncall-bot: Internal note: external publish requires "incident_committer" permission. Current oncall (alex) does not have publish rights. Please assign or confirm who should push to status site.

cs-ops: I can take the customer outreach for paying accounts — do you want me to send the short template email once the external notice is live? Also confirm whether we should include an ETA in the CS note or say "TBD".

sara: alex — can you change the Next update window to 15 minutes (per product-ops) and add the support link inline (done in the updated draft). otherwise lgtm. small nit: swap "ap-northeast-1" -> "ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo)" to help customers unfamiliar with region codes.

alex: done. final check: @sara sign off? @product-ops confirm cadence. If both approve I'll ask infra for temporary publish role or ask @ops-admin to publish. cs-ops please prepare the CS template and hold.

product-ops: approve for publish cadence 15m. please include a short "what we are doing" bullet that mentions "no data loss expected" to reassure customers where appropriate.

alex: incorporated "no data loss expected" line. Asking ops-admin for publish escalate now (pinged in ops-admin channel).

incident-bot: External status page update queued — initial notice will be published once an incident_committer approves. (auto)

ops-admin: I granted temporary incident_committer to alex for this incident. Publish away.

alex: publishing the initial external notice now.

incident-bot: External status page updated at 2026-03-15T08:28:10Z — Incident 1867777777: "Embeddings API partial outage in ap-northeast-1". Initial update posted.

mohsin: CS team will send targeted notices to impacted paying customers now that external post is live. I’ll attach the list of affected accounts to the ticket.

alex: thanks everyone. continuing mitigation and will post regular updates (every 15m) until resolved. will close thread with resolved notice once all health checks return to baseline. :white_check_mark:
